# `unused-private-declaration`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: quick fix · Options: none

Reports a private declaration that is never referenced in its file.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Dead declarations increase search noise and can preserve obsolete assumptions or
dependencies.

## When it fires

It applies to file-local declarations; public and externally reachable
declarations are outside this proof.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
fn helper() void {}

pub fn main() void {}
```
